title: FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves
summary: Unreal Engine 5 titles that crash on the first cutscene. The carrier sits under a compiler-named subfolder, which the script discovers rather than assumes.

credits.name: NotProtonNot
credits.note: NotProton's creator found that the game needs the Unreal fix with all three halves on, and handed us the change that adds it.

excerpts.note: Electra asks the H.264 decoder for the types it can output; CrossOver's offers no NV12, so the fix puts NV12 back in the list.
Sets Electra.Win.H264UseOldOutputPath, found by its own name rather than by an address, so Electra takes its CPU buffer path and never the D3D one.

symptom: The startup video plays with sound and no picture, and the game closes by itself.
fix: All three halves of the Unreal fix: Electra's VPx threshold raised, the adapter-node walk guarded, and Electra's H.264 back on NV12 and its CPU buffer path.
cause: Electra plays the game's H.264 video through a Media Foundation decoder that offers no NV12 under Wine, so the picture never reaches the screen.
